occupations.title: Sales Managers
occupations.rationale: Pipedrive is a sales CRM that provides tools for team monitoring, goal-setting, and refining strategy with real-time performance insights, and a "Sales Manager" is quoted as a user [D:Pipedrive:landing:2, D:Pipedrive:landing:5].

occupations.title: Sales Representatives of Services, Except Advertising, Insurance, Financial Services, and Travel
occupations.rationale: The product is described as a tool for salespeople to track their sales pipeline, manage deals, automate their sales process, and ultimately "focus on selling" and "closing deals" [D:Pipedrive:landing:1, D:Pipedrive:landing:6].

occupations.title: Chief Executives
occupations.rationale: A "CEO and Founder" is quoted as a user, and the software provides high-level business insights such as real-time sales reports and predictable revenue forecasting [D:Pipedrive:landing:2, D:Pipedrive:landing:4].
